item.title: Meet KENT, Building Super Natural Basics Without Plastic
item.description: KENT is redefining underwear with 100 percent natural, plastic free materials. Founder Stacy Grace shares how super natural basics can protect human health, reduce waste, and return clothing to the earth instead of landfills.

item.title: Causeartist Weekly #307: A $2.85M Ton Carbon Deal and the Fashion Built to Last
item.description: This week’s Causeartist Weekly covers a landmark carbon removal deal with Microsoft, enduring ethical brands like Eileen Fisher, new climate and biodiversity funding, and the accelerators and capital shaping what lasts in impact.

item.title: Meet Daring Capital: Rebuilding Early Stage Impact Funding from the Founder’s Seat
item.description: Jem Stein, founder of Daring Capital, shares why early stage impact funding fails founders, who gets overlooked by investors, and what the UK ecosystem must change to back durable, mission driven businesses.

item.title: Microplastics: Definition + Examples
item.description: Microplastics are solid plastic particles, typically composed of synthetic polymers, measuring less than 5 millimeters in diameter.

item.title: 50 Social Entrepreneurs to Watch for in 2026
item.description: Meet 50 social entrepreneurs to watch in 2026 who are building profitable, impact driven companies across climate tech, healthcare, fintech, and sustainable supply chains.

item.title: Thrive Market: Impact Business Case Study
item.description: A deep dive into Thrive Market’s business model, growth strategy, and mission driven approach to making healthy and sustainable food more affordable for millions of households.

item.description: In this issue, we highlight innovators to watch in 2026, explore how the Perkins Howe and Adaptation Ventures collaboration is unlocking DisabilityTech, and track over $500M in new fund closes across climate and sustainable tech.

item.title: Aspiration: Business Case Study

item.description: This week: Obvious Ventures closes $360M for planetary health, Daphni backs science-based startups with €260M, and Stanford hosts a career fair connecting mission-driven talent with purpose-first employers.

item.title: IBM Opens $45M AI Accelerator for Education and Workforce Nonprofits
item.description: IBM launched a global RFP for its Impact Accelerator program, seeking nonprofits and government organizations to develop AI-driven solutions for education and workforce development. Selected organizations receive two-year grants including watsonx access and IBM consulting support.
